== Notes ==
* The spell requires the target to leave an exploitable [[corpse]]; but does ''not'' exploit the corpse.
* Healing modifiers [[Effect stacking|stack multiplicatively]]. Combining with [[Deep Wound]] or [[Lingering Curse]] will amount to -36% healing.
* [[Verata's Gaze]] can be used to gain control of the masterless Bone Horror.
** Alternatively, if you do not intend to take control of the minion, [[Swap]] can be used to shadow step it away from your team (preferably in the opposing team). It also provides a suitable target to trigger the bonus effects of [[Holy Spear]].
* Heroes tend to spam this skill regardless of whether the target or enemy group has healing skills, leading to several extra Bone Horrors per fight.
* Since the Bone Horror is created masterless, it will not trigger skills that depend on [[Summoned creature#Skills that trigger by summoning creatures|summoned creature creation]] such as [[Boon of Creation]]. It also does not gain extra max health from Spawning Power. 

{{anomaly|Cannot be used on non-[[fleshy]] targets.}}

== Trivia ==
* Possibly meant to be an "evil" version of the [[Monk]] skill {{skill icon|Divine Intervention}}, which similarly triggers on death.
